analysis.headline: Energy and Healthcare Maintain Leadership While Industrials and Retail Deteriorate in Mixed Multi-Horizon Rotation
analysis.market_regime: Defensive and Resource Leadership with Mixed Horizon Signals Across Broad Equity Benchmarks
analysis.executive_summary: The rotation landscape exhibits persistent leadership in Energy (XLE) and Healthcare (XLV, XPH), alongside emerging strength in Energy sub-sectors (OIH) and Materials (XLB). Conversely, Consumer Discretionary sub-sectors (XRT) and Industrials (ITA, XLI) show weakening relative leadership. Several broader international and style benchmarks display divergent relative strength across 20-bar and 63-bar horizons, while defensive sectors such as Utilities (XLU) show pending early-warning reversals from confirmed rotation-out states.

emerging_rotations.title: Oil Services Displays Strong Emerging Acceleration
emerging_rotations.explanation: OIH maintains a confirmed trend state of EMERGING with a rotation score of 79.81, matching its 63-bar score high. It exhibits a 20-bar score change of 36.66 and a 5-bar score change of 21.29. Relative strength is aligned positively across both horizons, with 20-bar relative strength at 11.07 percentage points and 63-bar relative strength at 0.66 percentage points.

emerging_rotations.title: Materials Sector Shows Emerging Relative Improvement
emerging_rotations.explanation: XLB holds a confirmed trend state of EMERGING with a score of 69.09, backed by a 20-bar score change of 32.27 despite a 5-bar score change of -7.27. Relative strength is aligned across horizons, with 20-bar relative strength at 2.06 percentage points and 63-bar relative strength at 2.48 percentage points.

accelerating_rotations.title: Germany Retains Confirmed Accelerating State with Split Horizon RS
accelerating_rotations.explanation: EWG holds a confirmed trend state of ACCELERATING with a score of 65.43, supported by a 5-bar score change of 9.94 and a 20-bar score change of 4.21. A pending raw condition of NEUTRAL is noted at 1/3 observations. Relative strength displays divergent horizons, as 20-bar relative strength is negative at -0.34 percentage points while 63-bar relative strength remains positive at 2.03 percentage points.

persistent_leaders.title: Energy Sector Preserves Top-Ranked Persistent Leadership
persistent_leaders.explanation: XLE retains its confirmed trend state of PERSISTENT_LEADER with a group-leading score of 93.75, backed by a 20-bar score change of 26.93 and a minor 5-bar score change of -0.34. Relative leadership is confirmed on both horizons with 20-bar relative strength of 11.92 percentage points and 63-bar relative strength of 12.01 percentage points.

persistent_leaders.title: Pharmaceuticals Displays Sustained Long-Horizon Dominance
persistent_leaders.explanation: XPH maintains a confirmed trend state of PERSISTENT_LEADER with a score of 87.31, supported by a 5-bar score change of 3.23 and 20-bar score change of 5.83. Relative strength is robust across horizons, recording 20-bar relative strength of 2.26 percentage points and long-horizon 63-bar relative strength of 21.79 percentage points.

reaccelerating_rotations.title: New Zealand Confirms Reacceleration with Horizon Divergence
reaccelerating_rotations.explanation: ENZL retains a confirmed trend state of REACCELERATING with a score of 64.57, reflecting a modest 5-bar score change of 0.43 following a 20-bar score change of -14.09. Evidence across relative strength horizons is split, with 20-bar relative strength at -0.2 percentage points and 63-bar relative strength positive at 2.95 percentage points.

weakening_rotations.title: Retail Sector Displays Sharp Weakening with Horizon Split
weakening_rotations.explanation: XRT carries a confirmed trend state of WEAKENING with a score of 30.0, driven by a 20-bar score change of -35.19 and a 5-bar score change of -18.33. Relative strength exhibits conflicting horizons, with short-term 20-bar relative strength at -7.1 percentage points while longer-term 63-bar relative strength stands at 2.18 percentage points.

weakening_rotations.title: Aerospace & Defense Deteriorates to 63-Bar Score Low
weakening_rotations.explanation: ITA holds a confirmed trend state of WEAKENING with a score of 23.08, matching its 63-bar score low and registering a pending raw condition of ROTATION_OUT at 1/3 observations. Its 20-bar score change is -31.74 and 5-bar score change is -15.81, with negative relative strength across both horizons at -8.44 percentage points for 20-bar and -1.99 percentage points for 63-bar.

rotation_out.title: Utilities Sector Holds Confirmed Rotation Out State
rotation_out.explanation: XLU retains a confirmed trend state of ROTATION_OUT with a score of 40.45. It displays an early-warning pending raw condition of NEUTRAL at 2/3 observations, supported by a 5-bar score change of 17.73 and 20-bar score change of 10.91. However, confirmed relative strength remains negative on both horizons at -6.04 percentage points for 20-bar and -2.78 percentage points for 63-bar.

rotation_out.title: Qatar Remains in Rotation Out Despite Short-Term Score Rebound
rotation_out.explanation: QAT holds a confirmed trend state of ROTATION_OUT with a score of 38.0. A pending raw condition of NEUTRAL is noted at 2/3 observations alongside a 5-bar score change of 14.1 and 20-bar score change of 8.73. Confirmed relative strength is negative on both horizons, registering -3.63 percentage points over 20 bars and -7.27 percentage points over 63 bars.

geographic_rotations.title: Turkey Leads Emerging Europe at 63-Bar Score High
geographic_rotations.explanation: TUR holds a confirmed trend state of PERSISTENT_LEADER with a score of 87.86, representing a 63-bar score high. It exhibits a 20-bar score change of 53.71 and a 5-bar score change of 22.49. Relative strength is positive on both horizons, at 4.06 percentage points over 20 bars and 3.3 percentage points over 63 bars.

geographic_rotations.title: Asia Ex-Japan Rebound Features Divergent RS Horizons
geographic_rotations.explanation: AAXJ has a confirmed trend state of EMERGING with a score of 70.0, driven by a 5-bar score change of 35.0 and a 20-bar score change of 35.0. Evidence across horizons is divergent, with 20-bar relative strength positive at 2.59 percentage points while 63-bar relative strength remains negative at -5.9 percentage points.

pair_relationships.title: Growth vs Value Pair Exhibits Horizon Spread Divergence
pair_relationships.explanation: IWF holds a confirmed trend state of NEUTRAL against paired ticker IWD in the Growth vs Value relationship. Score momentum shows improvement with a 5-bar score change of 10.08 and a 20-bar score change of 22.92. Relative strength and pair spreads versus IWD are split across horizons, showing a positive 20-bar relative strength and pair spread of 0.47 percentage points but a negative 63-bar relative strength and pair spread of -13.15 percentage points.

pair_relationships.title: Equal-Weight vs Cap-Weight Pair Reflects Mixed Horizon Spread
pair_relationships.explanation: RSP holds a confirmed trend state of WEAKENING relative to paired ticker SPY in the Equal Weight vs Cap Weight comparison, with a pending raw condition of NEUTRAL at 2/3 observations. It registers a 5-bar score change of -0.66 and a 20-bar score change of 2.87. Relative strength and pair spread evidence versus SPY is mixed across horizons, with a negative 20-bar relative strength and pair spread of -0.19 percentage points contrasting with a positive 63-bar relative strength and pair spread of 3.89 percentage points.

cross_market_confirmations: Energy leadership is confirmed across global and domestic markets, with XLE (PERSISTENT_LEADER, score 93.75) corroborated by OIH (EMERGING, score 79.81) and global counterpart IXC (NEUTRAL confirmed, raw PERSISTENT_LEADER pending 1/3 days, score 88.0).
Materials sector improvement is confirmed domestically and internationally, as XLB (EMERGING, score 69.09) aligns with MXI (PERSISTENT_LEADER, score 82.78).

Healthcare strength is reflected in both broader US benchmarks (XLV, PERSISTENT_LEADER, score 73.75) and specialized sub-industries (XPH, PERSISTENT_LEADER, score 87.31; XBI, PERSISTENT_LEADER, score 83.65).
risks_or_conflicts: Mixed-horizon relative strength creates conflict in several key assets, including IWF vs IWD (20-bar pair spread +0.47 percentage points vs 63-bar pair spread -13.15 percentage points) and EWY (20-bar RS +10.57 percentage points vs 63-bar RS -18.27 percentage points).

Pending trend changes introduce early warning tensions, such as XOP being confirmed EMERGING while raw state is PERSISTENT_LEADER (2/3 observations), and XLU being confirmed ROTATION_OUT while raw state is NEUTRAL (2/3 observations).

Divergence between short-term participation and momentum is evident in PBJ, which reached a 63-bar score high of 55.83 with a 5-bar score change of 24.91, despite exhibiting an extreme negative CMF20 of -0.543.
analysis.methodology_note: Interpretation uses Python-confirmed trend states that require 3 consecutive daily observations before a new raw condition becomes canonical. Raw conditions remain available as pending early warnings. Evidence also uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, persistence metrics, and Python-calculated attention flags including 63-bar rotation-score extrema and material cross-market conflicts. ETF volume and CMF are treated as market-participation indicators, not fund-flow data.
